cursor.note: A decompose sub-problem gains `writes_to` — the addresses a piece's output lands at, existing or not — and it becomes the source of aider's editable file list, demoting `uses` (survey HOLDINGS, things that exist) to read-only. Measured at the first live drive of aider-builds-a-piece: the brief handed the apprentice the file the piece READS and the piece's job was to create a file nothing named. Strictness splits across the two mouths on purpose — the berth door refuses a new packet whose piece lacks the field, the promotion judge checks only a field that is PRESENT — so the 51 standing berths are not retro-redded by a spec that did not exist when they were written (Law 9's bound read the other way). THE CROSSING RIDES THIS ADDRESS BECAUSE THE TICKET'S owning_intention IS THIS CHARTER, and this component has carried no history until now — the pair is born here. The voyage writes at three addresses (this one, cairn/machines/build_inspector, cairn/devices/aider_shim); 77 of 78 ticketed crossings in the corpus journal at one address, and the one exception is not a precedent worth minting a second here.
